title: Advanced Marble Maze Tilt with Scoring System
prompt:
Create a complete HTML file with an advanced 3D marble maze tilt game using Three.js. The game features a tiltable maze board, a rolling marble, collectible gems, hazard zones, and a scoring system.

## Scene Setup
- Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 12, 8) looking down at the maze board.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a directional light at (5, 10, 5) with intensity 0.8, casting shadows.
- Set the renderer background to 0x1a1a2e. Enable shadows on the renderer.
- Load the 'DragonAttenuation.glb' model using GLTFLoader from a CDN (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js). Scale the dragon model to (0.3, 0.3, 0.3) and place it at the center of the maze as a decorative trophy/goal object at position (0, 0.5, 0). The marble must reach this dragon to win.

## Maze Board
- Create a flat rectangular board (16 x 0.3 x 16) using MeshStandardMaterial with color 0x2d4a3e.
- Add raised wall segments (BoxGeometry) around the perimeter and inside the maze to create pathways. Walls should be 0.5 units tall, 0.3 units thick, and colored 0x5a3a1a.
- Create at least 8 internal wall segments forming a maze pattern. The maze should have a clear path from the start corner (-6, 0.15, -6) to the center (0, 0, 0) where the dragon sits.

## Marble
- Create a sphere (radius 0.35) with MeshStandardMaterial, color 0x4488ff, metalness 0.7, roughness 0.2.
- Start position: (-6, 0.5, -6).
- Implement simple physics: the marble rolls based on the board tilt angle. Use velocity and acceleration vectors. Apply gravity component based on tilt (acceleration = tiltAngle * 9.8). Add friction (damping factor 0.98 per frame).
- Detect collisions with walls using AABB checks. On collision, reverse the velocity component perpendicular to the wall and apply a 0.5 restitution factor.
- Keep the marble on the board surface at all times.

## Collectible Gems
- Place 5 gem objects (small octahedron geometry, radius 0.25) at these positions: (-4, 0.4, -2), (-2, 0.4, 2), (2, 0.4, -4), (4, 0.4, 0), (0, 0.4, 4). Color them 0xffdd00 with emissive 0xffaa00.
- Gems rotate slowly (1 rad/s on Y axis) and bob up/down (amplitude 0.1, frequency 2).
- When the marble center is within 0.7 units of a gem, the gem is collected: remove it from scene, increment score by 100, play a visual flash effect.

## Hazard Zones
- Place 3 red hazard zones (flat red circles, radius 1.0) at positions: (2, 0.02, 2), (-3, 0.02, 3), (4, 0.02, -2). Color 0xff0000 with opacity 0.5, transparent.
- If the marble enters a hazard zone (distance < 1.0 from center), the player loses a life and the marble resets to start position. Brief invincibility (2 seconds) after respawn.

## Controls
- Arrow keys tilt the board. Max tilt angle: 0.15 radians in each direction.
- Tilt speed: 0.003 radians per frame when key is held. When released, tilt returns to 0 at 0.002 radians per frame.
- ArrowUp tilts board so marble rolls toward -Z, ArrowDown toward +Z, ArrowLeft toward -X, ArrowRight toward +X.
- Press 'R' key to reset the game entirely.
- Add a 'Start Game' button (DOM element, id='startBtn') that begins the game. Before clicking, marble is frozen.

## Scoring & HUD
- Display a HUD overlay (DOM) showing: Score (id='scoreDisplay'), Lives (id='livesDisplay', start with 3), Timer (id='timerDisplay', counts up in seconds), and Game Status (id='statusDisplay').
- Style the HUD with white text, font-size 18px, positioned at top-left with padding 15px.
- When all 5 gems are collected AND the marble reaches the dragon (within 1.0 unit of center), the player wins. Display 'YOU WIN!' in statusDisplay.
- When lives reach 0, game over. Display 'GAME OVER' in statusDisplay.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame:
- gameStarted: boolean (false until Start button clicked)
- gameOver: boolean
- gameWon: boolean
- score: number (starts at 0, +100 per gem)
- lives: number (starts at 3)
- gemsCollected: number (0-5)
- gemsRemaining: number (5-0)
- marblePosition: {x, y, z} (current marble position)
- marbleVelocity: {x, y, z} (current marble velocity)
- boardTiltX: number (current tilt in radians around X axis)
- boardTiltZ: number (current tilt in radians around Z axis)
- elapsedTime: number (seconds since game started, 0 before start)
- dragonLoaded: boolean (true once GLB model is loaded)
- isInvincible: boolean (true during respawn invincibility)
- hazardHits: number (total times marble hit hazard zones)

Ensure all numerical values are never NaN. Clamp marble position to board bounds (-7.5 to 7.5 on X and Z). Clamp tilt angles to [-0.15, 0.15].
physics_constraints: Marble acceleration proportional to sin(tiltAngle) * gravity. Velocity damped by 0.98 per frame. Wall collisions use AABB with 0.5 restitution. Marble stays on board surface (Y ≈ 0.5). Board tilt clamped to ±0.15 radians. Marble position clamped to ±7.5 on X and Z axes.
